name: Wheat
overview: Scripture presents wheat as a symbol of provision and blessing, as seen in God's provision of the finest wheat and oil for His people (Numbers 18:12; Psalms 81:16; Psalms 147:14). Wheat was a staple crop grown in Palestine and used in offerings, demonstrating its sacred role in worship and daily sustenance (1 Kings 5:11; Numbers 18:12). Additionally, wheat imagery is employed figuratively to illustrate human folly and the consequences of sin, as in the admonition that crushing a fool among wheat will not remove his foolishness (Proverbs 27:22) and the warning that sowing wheat but reaping thorns reflects the judgment of the Lord (Jeremiah 12:13).
